title: Your House Is My House
description: Real estate agent, Joanna Loudon, takes you through some of the fabulous homes that are on the market and takes questions from viewers. Early episodes feature soap opera star, Justin Witter.
quote: That fireplace is making me hot, if you know what I mean.
